verdict.rationale: mParticle documents audience creation, connecting audiences to activation outputs (ad platforms, marketing tools) via the Integrations directory, and a real-time API plus composable audiences for dynamic segmentation, supporting continuous activation flows. However, no evidence explicitly confirms near-real-time membership entry/exit sync cadence or latency guarantees for ad-platform audience updates. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sync frequency/latency for audience membership changes, independent verification of real-time add/remove behavior on ad platforms.
